title: Tailwise Autoship Shipping and Handling Tariff
content:
Tailwise Autoship shipping and handling charges are set per program. This tariff states the free-shipping threshold, the standard shipping fee, the heavy-item surcharge with the weight at which it starts, and the cold-chain packaging settings for each program.

## Tariff

| | Everyday | Litter & Bulk | Fresh & Frozen | Custom Meal Plan | Pharmacy | Compounded Pharmacy |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free-shipping threshold, same-day combined Autoship merchandise subtotal (USD) | 49.00 | 49.00 | 99.00 | 0.00 | 49.00 | 49.00 |
| Standard shipping fee per shipment below the threshold (USD) | 4.95 | 4.95 | 9.95 | 0.00 | 4.95 | 4.95 |
| Heavy-item weight per unit, at or above (lb) | 40 | 35 | 40 | 40 | 40 | 40 |
| Heavy-item surcharge per heavy unit shipped (USD) | 6.99 | 4.99 | 6.99 | 0.00 | 6.99 | 6.99 |
| Ships refrigerated or frozen in insulated packaging | No | No | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Insulated packaging fee per shipment (USD) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 7.99 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 3.99 |
| Shipping ZIP must be inside the refrigerated delivery zone | No | No | Yes | Yes | No | No |

## Tariff notes

1. A threshold of 0.00 USD means the standard shipping fee is always waived; Autoship Custom Meal Plan carries that threshold and a standard fee of 0.00 USD.
2. The standard shipping fee is charged once per shipment below the threshold.
3. The heavy-item surcharge is charged per heavy unit shipped and is never waived by the free-shipping threshold.
4. A unit counts as heavy when its shipping weight is at or above the program's heavy-item weight: 35 lb on Autoship Litter & Bulk, 40 lb on every other program.

## Hypothetical units against the heavy-item weight

| Program | Hypothetical unit weight | Heavy-item weight | Heavy unit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Autoship Litter & Bulk | 35 lb | 35 lb | Yes, at the weight |
| Autoship Litter & Bulk | 34.9 lb | 35 lb | No |
| Autoship Everyday | 40 lb | 40 lb | Yes, at the weight |
| Autoship Everyday | 38 lb | 40 lb | No |
